info.title: kickNX
info.author: j2k
info.description: Kick streaming client for Nintendo Switch
info.details: kickNX is an independent Kick client built specifically for the Nintendo Switch. It brings livestream viewing, category discovery, search, and integrated chat interaction to handheld, tabletop, and docked play.

changelog:
v0.5.2
- Daily Reward bar above chat and a gift button on Home to track and claim Kick's daily watch reward
- Emote tabs: Recent, Channel, Global and Collectibles, with animated collectible emotes and subscriber emotes
- Followed channel cards show the live stream thumbnail
- Player Settings switch to turn watch time reporting off
- Fixes for Wi-Fi drops, chat reconnect loops, buffering and "Couldn't resolve host" errors
- Fixes for missing channel emotes, emotes turning into text and SSL errors when sending chat
- Sharper event cards and no more stretched thumbnails

v0.5.1
- Rewind a live stream back to its start: longer rewinds switch to the live VOD, with chat staying live
- Still-live broadcasts show as a LIVE now card on streamer pages
- Check for updates now installs the new version and restarts kickNX
- Scrub label over the progress bar and a larger live buffer (about 30 seconds)
- Live viewer counts on category and event cards
- Help screens when kickNX is opened from the Album
- Notes for text the Switch fonts cannot draw
- Faster Home and chat, and a fix for a crash after scrubbing

v0.5.0
- Colour themes: OLED, Dark Grey and Kick, chosen from the Theme button on Home
- Live events row with event pages showing live streams and popular clips
- In-app on-screen chat keyboard in landscape, with an Emotes key
- Hold A on the progress bar and use the left stick or D-pad to scrub
- Check for updates button on the About page
- Kick-only client: Jellyfin, media library and other non-Kick features removed
- Offline streams return to the previous screen automatically
- Right-stick scrolling and touch-to-controller fixes
- Fixes for SSL connect errors, a crash after closing a stream quickly, and a damaged settings file

v0.4.0
Initial release of kickNX for Nintendo Switch.
